title: A mailbox send can persist but return no receipt to the caller, and a retry with the same idempotency key is then refused as "used for a different message"
outcome: A termal_send_to_session (or CLI mailbox send) that durably appends a message always gives the caller a receipt, or a retry with the SAME intent and key returns that original message with duplicate=true. The caller can always tell "not appended" from "appended without a receipt" and retry safely. A 409 "key used for a different message" happens only when the content genuinely differs, and then names what differs.
acceptance: A mailbox send can persist but return no receipt to the caller, and a retry with the same idempotency key is then refused as "used for a different message" is done
